title: If You Ever See Square Waves in the Ocean, Get Out Immediately
description:
The ocean turning into a giant checkerboard looks amazing — it's actually one of the most dangerous things the sea can do. Here are 7 warning signs nature gives you right before things go very wrong, and exactly what to do when you spot them. Number 2 might be hiding in your own backyard.

⏱️ CHAPTERS
0:00 The checkerboard ocean
0:24 #7 Square waves (cross sea)
0:58 #6 The ocean suddenly disappears
1:29 #5 A green sky
1:58 #4 The calm patch of water (rip current)
2:32 #3 Trees shaped like the letter J
3:03 #2 A circle of dead grass in your yard
3:39 #1 The forest goes silent
4:13 The golden rule + recap

Have you ever seen one of these signs in real life? Tell me in the comments — I read all of them.
